Search for the alpha achieving a target value (deprecated)

Source: R/deprecated.R
estimate.alpha.fun.Rd

estimate.alpha.fun() is deprecated as of MultiStateTMLE 0.1.0. Use solve_alpha() instead.

Usage

estimate.alpha.fun(
  theta,
  fun,
  c_n,
  alpha_init = 1,
  expand_up = 2,
  expand_down = 0.25,
  max_iter = 100,
  alpha_min = 0.001,
  alpha_max = 100,
  use.cores = 1,
  verbose = FALSE,
  trace_every = 1L
)

Arguments

theta, fun, c_n, alpha_init, expand_up, expand_down, max_iter, alpha_min, alpha_max, verbose, trace_every

See solve_alpha().

use.cores

Ignored.

Value

See solve_alpha().
